series.name: The Home Portrait
series.audience: Full marketing list, minus contacts already tagged home portrait quiz (they have their portrait) and anyone under contract.
series.goal: Quiz starts. Every email has one job: send the reader to the quiz.

series.name: Mitchell Design Dollars
series.audience: Warm audiences and the database only, per the approved rollout. Full marketing list, minus anyone already under contract.
series.goal: Design Center conversations and reservations before the October 31 reserve by date.

series.name: The Four Buyers
series.audience: Landowner segment (registered as owns land, or quiz contacts tagged with land) for the first four; the looking for land segment gets the fifth. Send to Virginia and Maryland contacts first; the Dreamer and No Land emails have Carolinas versions.
series.goal: Visits to the matching page and calls to a New Home Consultant. Each email carries one argument and one page.

series.name: Realtors and homeowners
series.audience: Realtor and broker contacts (land listing agents first), and past Mitchell homeowners.
series.goal: Referrals into the quiz and the Design Dollars page from people who already know buyers.
